result.reason: H-NOTOOL is the strongest next frontier candidate: it describes a concrete, observed misclassification event at a ToolBridge boundary with an owner task and a bounded reproduction request already in place. The evidence gap is crisp (exact causal control/state interaction) and closing it could materially change the frontier by either confirming an authority-boundary violation or proving Harness correctness—both outcomes are decision-relevant now. H-DISCOVERY is a close second (efficiency question with proven authority), and S-UNKNOWN is third (narrow adapter gap, exact patch path unclosed). WITNESS is prevention-focused but current witnesses are admitted-safe-by-design; HOST-PKG and G-HUMAN lack the decisive near-term evidence potential (G-HUMAN is gated on human responses that may never arrive at useful volume). F-LIVE is high-value but consequence-bearing real-capital work better deferred until the unresolved correctness questions in H-NOTOOL/H-DISCOVERY/S-UNKNOWN stabilize the harness boundary.

result.reason:
F-LIVE is the clear frontier mover: it advances real capital across an independent authority boundary with real consequence, and its next observation (does the canary reach the live effect boundary without duplicate POST and reconcile) is a single explicit pass/fail that discriminates whether the pre-dispatch chain is causally complete. This is high value, small falsifier, and owner-native (finance owns the executor authority). It is deferred-infeasible for others, not crowded, and its evidence changes the next frontier regardless of outcome.

R-WITNESS ranks second: it is the tightest physical adversarial experiment with a concrete falsifier (can P3 witnesses be evaded by same-authority namespace/path manipulation), and it directly gates whether current witnesses are prevention or only detection — but the known frontier already states they fail closed, so the marginal claim is narrower than F-LIVE's.

S-UNKNOWN (rank 3) is a narrow adapter representation gap already owner-identified with an exact—though unclosed—patch path; high tractability but low frontier-changing surprise; it closes a known hole rather than opening one.

H-NOTOOL (rank 4) has a bounded reproduction request and read-only-first authority, so its evidence cost is low and it's owner-native; but it risks semantic movement and its falsifier is about one misclassified correction event — a narrow in-Harness control question, less consequential than the other harness item below cost-wise.

H-DISCOVERY (rank 5) has genuine frontier-changing potential (can ~small observation plans preserve causal admission quality vs 203?), but it requires building and measuring a full observation-plan experiment — higher evidence budget than R-WITNESS/F-LIVE, and no preselected source bug means the yield is uncertain.

HOST-PKG (rank 6) is the most tractable (pure packaging graph measurement) but is a closed mechanical cost question with low frontier surprise — the 9→34 expansion is already World-observed; a smaller dep graph is engineering polish, not frontier-shifting.

G-HUMAN is deferred entirely: it cannot be advanced this cycle because it requires real human play and sits at 0/11 responses — no available owner-native observation can move the frontier now, so any budget is stranded. This is the clean abstain on prior 5 (stop when no observation can justify the target).
